text:
Priya: quick heads-up — Candidate K is on a 24h interview window tomorrow 10:00–16:00 PT. I'm coordinating coverage and a debrief owner. need fast confirmations please.

Priya: asks: 1) backup for 11:00–12:00 PT if Jo can't make it? 2) who can take the 16:30 debrief (30m async preferred)? 3) confirm rubric anchors: coding 50%, system design 30%, culture 20% — any objections?

Marcos: I can cover 11–12 PT if needed. :raising_hand:

Elena: I can take the 16:30 debrief — ok to run async notes in doc and post summary?

Samir: +1 on rubric weights, but suggest we call out "clarity of tradeoffs" under system design explicitly.

Aisha: small ask — candidate requested transcript and recording consent. Are we good to record? ops-runbook says consent must be explicit.

Priya: good point. Ops Bot, mark consent required and post runbook link?

Ops Bot: Reminder: Recording consent required per Hiring Runbook — https://redwood.internal/runbooks/interviews/recording-consent. Please use template: `Recording consent: I consent to being recorded for interview evaluation purposes.`

Priya: thanks. Elena — please add that template to your calendar invite and to the scribe doc.

Elena: done. Added consent template to invite + scribe sheet. link: https://docs.internal/scribes/candidate-K-24h

Marcos: quick note — I still need the candidate's homework PR to skim before 11. Priya, can you re-share?

Priya: re-shared: https://github.com/redwood-infra/recruitment/pull/482 — last update this morning, small refactor + tests.

Marcos: saw it, will skim on train — if anything blocking I'll ping.

Samir: for debrief owner, I'm happy to collect scores and normalize. I'll run the quick normalization: z-score across reviewers and flag >1.5 stdev differences for follow-up.

Priya: taking that — thanks Samir. Action list: Marcos backup 11–12, Elena debrief + scribe + add consent, Samir aggregates scores.

Aisha: one more — can someone confirm interviewer Jo's timezone? invite shows UTC+1 but calendar shows PST. want to avoid no-shows.

Priya: Jo is in CET this week (UTC+1). We scheduled them for 18:00 CET which is 10:00 PT — confirmed. I pinged Jo separately.

Marcos: thanks. small CR ping: I left a review comment on the homework PR about an unmocked external call — tagging @jo because it affects the 11:30 session if they want to probe it live.

Priya: good catch. @Jo if you see Marcos' comment can you ACK?

Ops Bot: Deploy reminder: please ensure the candidate scribe doc has edit permissions for panelists only. Using `interviews-scribes` group is recommended.

Elena: scribe doc permissions are set to interviews-scribes group.

Samir: final note on scoring rubric — I'll post the simple scoring sheet (0–5 per anchor) into the doc this afternoon so reviewers have consistent buckets.

Priya: perfect. if no more blockers I'll close this thread in the morning and post the final coverage table. thanks everyone! :thumbsup:

Marcos: noted.

Elena: all set on my side.

Jo: (DM) Confirmed — saw the PR comment, will prep follow-ups.

Priya: thanks Jo. last_message: posted final coverage table in calendar event and pinned scribe doc.

Ops Bot: Thread closed by Priya (auto-note).
